cd /workspace/project && cat > OPENHANDS_OB_CONFIG.md <<'EOF'
# Konfigurasi OpenHands — profil obscurify (dipulihkan dari riwayat)
Sumber: event percakapan di `/var/openhands/conversations/*/events/`
(konfigurasi tersimpan di Cloud, tapi tercatat di log saat percakapan mulai).
## Profil yang dipakai: `Obcurify`
| Field | Nilai |
|---|---|
| model | `openai/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored` |
| base_url | `https://obscurify.ai` |
| auth_type | `api_key` |
| provider_connection_id | `2d402186488f4b1abc3fcbfaa44a255b` |
| stream | `True` |
| caching_prompt | `True` |
| native_tool_calling | `True` |
| api_mode | `auto` |
| drop_params | `True` |
| timeout | `300` |
| num_retries | `5` (multiplier 8.0, min 8, max 64) |
| reasoning_effort | `high` |
| extended_thinking_budget | `200000` |
| prompt_cache_retention | `24h` |
| max_message_chars | `30000` |
## Catatan penting
**base_url tanpa `/v1` tetap jalan.** Terbukti diuji:
```
base=https://obscurify.ai      -> ✅ 200
base=https://obscurify.ai/v1   -> ✅ 200
```
Obscurify menerima `/chat/completions` maupun `/v1/chat/completions`.
## Percobaan model abliterated:thinking
Pernah dicoba dengan:
```
model    : openai/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking
base_url : https://obscurify.ai/v1
```
(profil berbeda, tercatat di percakapan 8b55afd6)
## Cara memulihkan / membuat ulang
1. `app.all-hands.dev` -> Settings -> LLM -> **Available Profiles**
2. Klik tiga titik pada profil **Obcurify** -> **Set as Active**
3. Kalau perlu buat baru: Advanced -> Custom Model + Provider connection
   (connection `2d402186488f4b1abc3fcbfaa44a255b`, base `https://obscurify.ai`)
## Kalau semua model error
Penyebab: profil yang baru disimpan otomatis jadi aktif GLOBAL.
Obat: **Set as Active** ke profil `Obcurify` lagi.
EOF



git add -A && git -c user.name="openhands" -c user.email="openhands@all-hands.dev" commit -q -m "Recover OpenHands obscurify profile config from conversation logs" && git --no-pager log --oneline -1
